text:
Atascosa County districts report 35 Asian students enrolled for 2024-25
V. F. Bush
Atascosa County school districts counted 35 Asian students enrolled in the 2024-25 school year, unchanged from the prior school year, data from the Texas Education Agency shows.
Total enrollment across all Atascosa County school districts reached 9,046 students in the 2024-25 school year. Asian students comprised less than 1% of the total student population, ranking as the third least represented ethnic group in county districts.
Of the five Atascosa County districts, Pleasanton Independent School District had the largest number of Asian students enrolled for the 2024-25 school year, reporting 14 students.
Main district offices referenced in this report are found in cities within Atascosa County.
A 2026 WalletHub study ranked Texas among the least-educated states nationally, placing 41st out of 50 in terms of educational quality and outcomes.
Texas operates the second-largest K-12 public education system in the U.S., with about 5.5 million students and an average student-to-teacher ratio of about 15:1.
| District | % of Asian Students | Number of Asian Students | Total Enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pleasanton ISD | 0.4 | 14 | 3,406 |
| Lytle ISD | 0.6 | 11 | 1,825 |
| Jourdanton ISD | 0.5 | 7 | 1,554 |
| Poteet ISD | 0.2 | 3 | 1,837 |
| Charlotte ISD | 0 | 0 | 424 |
Information in this article was obtained from the Texas Education Agency. The source data can be found here.
